A full card image with the corrected text and a white E in the lower border, added to the Players Committee's Holotable image set on 27 September 2019.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-wookieeroar-PC-Errata-2019-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Wookiee Roar]]: The game text changes: “Chewbacca” becomes “Chewie”; “search through your” becomes “take Chewie into hand from”; “Deck and take Chewbacca into your hand. Shuffle deck, cut and replace.” becomes “Deck; reshuffle.”. A full card image (350 × 490 pixels).

The whole printed card image and the whole 2019 E card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
